guidance: A synthetic, neutral example. Copy it, then replace the owner, sources, selector and clauses with your team's confirmed expectations.

requirements.text: Show a filter bar above the first chart that stays visible while scrolling.
requirements.verify: Scroll the dashboard; the filter bar remains visible and controls every chart.

requirements.text: Every table and chart offers a CSV export of exactly the rows currently shown, respecting active filters.
requirements.verify: Apply a filter, export each table and chart, and compare the exported rows with the visible rows.

requirements.text: Limit the content width for readability.
requirements.verify: Inspect the rendered layout at 1920px wide.
Compare the primary accent with the setting.

requirements.text: Show the data freshness timestamp next to the dashboard title.
requirements.verify: Check the header for a last-updated timestamp.

sources.ref: Example operator statement: internal dashboards need visible filters and CSV export of the filtered rows.
sources.reuse: Synthetic example text; free to copy.

summary: Synthetic example: internal analytics dashboards with persistent filters, CSV export and a restrained palette.
